commit_message:
[Merged] [revec][wasm][turboshaft] Support intersecting ForcePackNode

The force-packed nodes are inconsecutive values by nature, which may
induce intersecting PackNode. The current node_to_packnode map can only
support 1:1 mapping that does not allow overlapped PackNode.

This patch adds new structures to store the intersected PackNodes and
make them mergable from other trees or branches in the same tree.
It also adds support of force-packing ReplaceLane operations which
is commonly accompanied by intersecting PackNodes in real-life cases.

pr_description:
Support overlapping force-packed SIMD nodes with intersecting PackNode mappings that can be combined across trees and branches, including force-packing ReplaceLane operations.

Track inputs reordered by previously accepted SLP trees and exclude them from force or intersect packing. Check side effects along input dependency traversals before moving operations earlier, refining effects for nontrapping word arithmetic. Reuse analyzer-owned traversal storage when reducing inputs.

ground_truth.reason: This PR includes the feature with the fix already applied, so the vulnerability is not present

fix_commit_message:
[wasm][revec] Fix force-packing input dependency issues

When check the input dependency of force-packing nodes, we need to
ensure no side effects between previous nodes before moving ahead.

The force-packing nodes can be the inputs of another force-packing node
that is reduced in advance, thus there is no guarantee that the input
index should be bigger than the current visiting index.

This patch adds side effect check in HasInputDependencies and prohibits
the reordered inputs to be force-packed to avoid above issues.

agent_reasoning: Without these dependency checks, force and intersect packing could accept nodes already scheduled earlier by another SLP tree or move inputs across conflicting side effects, producing incorrect generated code and crashes. The source edits apply the supplied reordered-input tracking, side-effect checks, effect refinement, and shared traversal storage to this snapshot's existing tree-merging API. Only the two specified source files were edited, and workspace validation confirmed that the resulting PR diff applies cleanly to intro_parent.
